product_metadata.title: Topfinel Buffalo Check Decorative Farmhouse Throw Pillow Covers 18 x 18 Inch Cotton Linen Classic Plaid Cushion Cover with Boho Tassels for Couch Car Decor 45 x 45 cm, Pack of 2, Black & Grey
features: SIZES & PACKAGE: 2pcs 18 x 18 Inch (45 x 45 cm) accent pillow covers per pack. NO PILLOW INSERTS, NO FILLER.
DURABLE & BREATHABLE: Made of 58% cotton and 42% linen blend, the unique combination of materials make this cushions cover extremely breathable and thick, skin-friendly to your families and pets.

CREATIVE DESIGN: Traditional buffalo check with playful tassels design make the pillow coves stand out in different places or holidays, simple unique design but also classic last forever. Pattern available on both sides.
INVISIBLE ZIPPER: A delicate invisible zipper closure 12.6"( 32cm) was designed to meet an elegant look. Tight zigzag over-lock stitches are to avoid being frayed and ripped.
WASHING GUIDE: Machine wash in cold water with gentle cycle or by hand. Do not use bleach. Tumble dry Low. It will be more soft and comfortable after every washing.
